season.evidence: Logged ascents Jul 8, Aug 7, Sep 5 (Oct 2); stored Jul-Sep; web (SummitPost route pages, trip reports): snow on the ridge into June, a May attempt was slowed by snow, tarn water scarce by late August.

track.why: Only one route is stored on this peak, and this 18 Jul 2026 summit track follows its line: Diablo (204 m from our trailhead pin), the Sourdough trail, off onto the open ridge, then brush and cliff terrain to the summit; the report mentions the dry creek descent, brush and a class 3 cliff section. The track ends at the summit (no return leg).

otherTracksConsidered.why: Ascends the east ridge from Stetattle and descends the west ridge, starting on the ridge itself; a different line and not a trailhead round trip.

facts.text: In mid-July there is no real climbers' path through the gap on the ridge; marking is sparse, so carry the track.
Going down, finding the dry creek bed is key; missing it means a long thrash through thick brush (mid-July).
The meadow-looking terrain includes an exposed class 3 cliff band and steep drop-offs; the way up is a bushwhack through dense brush.

notes: The harvest holds just two tracks. The stored trailhead pin (Sourdough Mountain Trailhead, Diablo) matches the track start, so no pin change. Summit pins agree with Peakbagger (~20 m).
